name: NetNeighbors
author: i12bp8
description: Fing-style Wi-Fi radar for the bar: one click shows every device on your network — vendor, hostname, MAC — and flags new ones that appear.

barWidget.description: Who's on this Wi-Fi? Scans the local network straight from the bar and lists every device with vendor, hostname and MAC. Rootless: reads the kernel neighbor table after a gentle probe sweep. No daemon, no privileges.
